summary: A busy provider must not turn into an error, and your retries must not make it worse. You set a timeout (the SDK default is 10 minutes), retry only what may go away with backoff, jitter and Retry-After, never retry a wrong key, and retry a stream only before its first piece. A pretend provider makes every scenario instant and testable.
goal: Retry a failed model call with backoff and jitter, and see every attempt in the logs.

items.text: Answer the two warm-up questions from memory, then guess the hook
Step 1: run retry_demo.py and match the four scenarios, including the waits
Step 2: set max_attempts to 2, predict the first scenario, then check
Step 3: make every error retryable and see a wrong key retried
Step 4: write the wrapper tests with a fake that fails on demand, and wire the wrapper into the real mode
Play the Retry Referee game to the end and see your score
